AnalysisIdentity.description:
Exact immutable analysis inputs; hashes are canonical SHA-256 digests.

Explicit null history_cursor identifies an empty append-only event history.
Omitting the cursor is invalid; callers must bind even the empty state.
AnalysisIdentity.title: AnalysisIdentity

AnalysisPolicy.description: Caller supplies tolerances and margin; no invented engineering defaults.
AnalysisPolicy.title: AnalysisPolicy

BeamDeflection.description: Prismatic Euler-Bernoulli beam; no cardboard shell or buckling inference.
BeamDeflection.title: BeamDeflection

JointDemand.description:
A named, explicitly supplied scalar failure-mode demand and allowable.

The stage adapter authenticates joint membership. A comparison does not solve
load distribution or infer peel, shear, moment and fatigue interaction.
JointDemand.title: JointDemand

MechanicalSnapshot.description:
Mechanical consumer projection, supplied by the canonical pose producer.

This is not a scene/pose producer. Nominal and observed are declarations,
never inferred evidence. Contacts and rigid-body applicability are explicit.
MechanicalSnapshot.title: MechanicalSnapshot

Point3.description: World SI coordinates: right-handed x/y, z upward; never viewer offsets.
Point3.title: Point3

QuantityEstimate.description:
A scalar, inclusive interval or unknown in an explicit SI unit.

Dependencies and correlation groups preserve shared uncertainty. Provenance is
descriptive, never a calibrated confidence probability or physical test result.
QuantityEstimate.title: QuantityEstimate

RepairPatch.description: Flat parameter edits, not executable operations or arbitrary JSON patches.
RepairPatch.title: RepairPatch

RigidTransform.description: Right-handed local-to-world rotation and translation in metres.
RigidTransform.title: RigidTransform

SlidingDemand.description: Single contact's supplied reaction demands, not a reaction-force solver.
SlidingDemand.title: SlidingDemand

stand_includes_all_parts_and_connectors.title: Stand Includes All Parts And Connectors

StabilityOverlay.description: Server-computed modeled geometry only, never physical evidence.
StabilityOverlay.title: StabilityOverlay

StabilityReport.description:
Modeled result only. Physical evidence references confer no physical pass.

Required coverage is the policy's case/check Cartesian product. Additional
cases may be reported, but cannot hide an unresolved required check.
StabilityReport.title: StabilityReport
